ety.text: мо́лния (mólnija) + -е- (-e-) + носи́ть (nosítʹ) + -ный (-nyj). Compare Macedonian молневит (molnevit), Serbo-Croatian муњевит. Compare typologically Macedonian секавичен (sekavičen) (< секавица (sekavica)), Polish błyskawiczny, błyskawicowy (< błyskawica), German blitzschnell, blitzgeschwind, blitzartig (< Blitz, whence блиц (blic)), Dutch bliksemsnel, Swedish blixtsnabb, Italian fulminee, Spanish fulminante (<< Latin fulmen, akin to fulgur, whence English fulgurant), Norwegian Bokmål lynrask, Danish lynhurtig. Outside PIE compare Mongolian цахим (caxim), Vietnamese chớp nhoáng.
